say:2:1410646001:0.text: The dragon still hasn't woken up. Did we miss something?
say:2:1410646001:0.source_cn: ……龙还没有醒来。是不是漏掉了什么？

say:3:1410646002:1.text: That can't be. I've checked everything along the way, and your queen only placed these two seals.
say:3:1410646002:1.source_cn: 不，我一路上看得仔仔细细！你们女王只设下了这两处束缚！

say:4:1410646003:0.text: I told you so! There's no way she could've kept the Primordial Dragon here on her own. It must take something as powerful as Helthor's power!
say:4:1410646003:0.source_cn: 我都说了，就凭她，怎么可能把初始之龙按在这里？只可能是...

say:5:1410646004:0.text: Then how can we awaken the dragon?
say:5:1410646004:0.source_cn: 那我们到底该如何唤醒龙？

say:6:1410646005:0.text: To untie the knot, you need the one who tied it...

say:7:1410646006:0.text: Stop saying nonsense. Helthor is long gone.
say:7:1410646006:0.source_cn: 别说傻话，赫托早就死了。

say:8:1410646007:0.text: I know, no need to remind me!

say:9:1410646008:0.text: Listen to me, do you understand the principle of resonance? Argh, forget it. What I'm trying to say is... if we can create a magical wave that mirrors Helthor's divine power...
say:9:1410646008:0.source_cn: 听我说，你们懂不懂共振原理？我的意思是……如果能用魔法...

say:10:1410646009:0.text: I'll forgive your nonsense for now, but we can't do it on our own.
say:10:1410646009:0.source_cn: 看在你不懂魔法的份上，我原谅你的胡言乱语。光靠我们，这...

say:11:1410646010:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think it's really impossible?
say:11:1410646010:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think it's really impossible?
say:11:1410646010:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think it's really impossible?

choice_prompt:14:1410646011.source_cn: 就像复活赫托需要载体，除非我们能拿到赫托的圣物，否则，想都别想。

say:15:1410646012:0.text: I guess that's our only option now. Let's go.
say:15:1410646012:0.source_cn: 为了唤醒初始之龙，这下是非去不可了。

say:16:1410646013:0.text: Hold up. We're almost at the volcano's mouth. Let's head up and get a better view—it should help us figure out where the temple is.
say:16:1410646013:0.source_cn: 等会儿，我们马上就到火山口了，先上去瞧瞧吧。也许能从高...

say:17:1410646014:0.text: This doesn't seem like the kind of place for a temple...
say:17:1410646014:0.source_cn: ……你们的神殿会造在这种地方？

say:18:1410646015:0.text: We won't know until we get a better look from above. Getting the lay of the land before moving forward is always smart!
say:18:1410646015:0.source_cn: 登高望远，先确认方位再行动，总不会错！

say:19:1410646016:0.text: Then, let's not waste time. Let's go.

choice:14:0:1.text: We should head to the temple.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 去矮人建造的神殿里找
choice:14:0:1.male: We should head to the temple.
